description: Source code for pin control driver for QuickLogic EOS S3 in Zephyr RTOS, including register configuration functions and pin setup logic.

methods.name: pinctrl_eos_s3_input_selection
methods.description: Configures the input selection register for a specific pin.

methods.name: pinctrl_eos_s3_set
methods.description: Sets the register value for a specific pin.

methods.name: pinctrl_eos_s3_configure_pin
methods.description: Configures individual pin settings such as function, drive strength, pull-up/down, and input enable.

methods.name: pinctrl_configure_pins
methods.description: Configures multiple pins based on provided pin configurations.
